review_method: Saved official-portal captures, current endpoint checks and independently registered European PDF artefacts; only completed responses are reported.

official_entry_points.note: Access-information page only; it is not a model- and edition-specific owner manual and does not establish any warning meaning.
No separate completed HTTP capture exists for this exact locale route. Its status must not be inferred from the completed /home/ capture.

completed_access_capture.ui_observation: The loaded application offered selection by VIN or by Sales region, Model, Model year and Language, for model years from 2008. The captured default locale was English (North America).

incomplete_access_attempt.result: No HTTP result was obtained before the request was terminated; this attempt does not supersede the completed 2026-10-29 capture.

interpretation: HTTP 200 for the application shell does not establish access to a particular manual.
HTTP 403 for /web/models/ is the exact completed observation; do not state that the whole Audi portal returned 403.
A GPSR sample identifier is manufacturer-published but is not a customer VIN and does not by itself establish model year, edition, market, language or publication code.
A calendar year or a visually similar symbol from another market or edition is not transferable evidence.

market_exclusion.rule: Only an explicitly European/RDW sales-region result with its actual language, edition or publication code and instruction content may support these three catalogue scopes.
